# Byline Sponsor Finance Supports R.M. Young Company in its Acquisition of Texas Electronics


November 24, 2026


Commercial Banking


Sponsor Finance Group


Deal Win


Media and Press


-
-
-
-


Byline Sponsor Finance (“BSF”), a division of Byline Bank, announced that it has provided financing to support R.M. Young Company, LLC (“R.M. Young”), a manufacturer of high-quality precision meteorological instrumentation backed by Benford Capital Partners (“BCP”), in its acquisition of Texas Electronics (“TE”). BSF was represented by Duane Morris, LLP.


Founded in 1956 and headquartered near Dallas, Texas, Texas Electronics is a leading North American provider of research-grade tipping bucket rain gauges.


BCP and R.M. Young believe the acquisition represents a compelling strategic opportunity, establishing a leading position in an important meteorological sensing category. By integrating Texas Electronics’ precipitation monitoring expertise, R.M. Young broadens its environmental sensing capabilities and strengthens its ability to deliver comprehensive environmental monitoring solutions.


“We’re excited to support R.M. Young’s acquisition of Texas Electronics, a highly strategic add-on that enhances the platform’s capabilities, expands its product offering, and further strengthens its position in environmental monitoring. Texas Electronics has built an impressive legacy and reputation for quality over many decades, making it a natural fit alongside R.M. Young,” said Sunay Salievski, Senior Director at Byline Sponsor Finance.


**About Byline Sponsor Finance**
Byline Sponsor Finance, with offices in Chicago, IL and Charlotte, NC provides senior secured cash flow loans to private equity backed lower middle market companies throughout the United States. BSF focuses on companies that generate EBITDA between $2-10 million with products that support the acquisition, recapitalization, and growth investment efforts of private equity firms operating in the lower middle market. For more information visit[www.bylinebank.com/sponsor-finance](http://www.bylinebank.com/sponsor-finance) .


**About Benford Capital Partners**
Founded in 2004, Benford Capital is a Chicago-based private equity firm focused on buying and building leading lower middle market companies in partnership with founders and management. Since inception, Benford Capital has acquired over 75 companies and currently owns 19 platform companies. BCP’s industry areas of focus include Industrial Distribution, Industrial Technology & Manufacturing, Specialty Services, Agricultural Products and Services, Food & Beverage, and Ingredients & Consumer Products. For more information, please visit[www.benfordcapital.com](http://www.benfordcapital.com/) .
